quality.baseline_std_repeatability_fallback_poli: Only when an edge has no normal-STD observation: require at least 3 distinct RTK-Fixed epochs, maximum vector deviation <= 0.050 m, and ECEF consistency error <= 0.050 m; retain the original high covariance

rolling_stability_policy.ewma_role: Early transition detector only; formal acceptance still requires two non-overlapping windows plus continuous hold

quality.temporary_base_coordinate_policy: One immutable covariance-weighted ECEF endpoint per rover, derived from the common initial fixed-BASE solver window and reused for MODE BASE, source validation, and network reduction
quality.vector_outlier_filter: Per edge/session coordinate-wise median center; reject 3-D deviation above max(0.25 m, median deviation + 8 x 1.4826 x MAD), minimum 5 samples
quality.position_type_selection_policy: Per geometric edge prefer RTK Fixed position type 4; use Input Fixed type 7 only when that edge has no accepted type 4 observation
quality.baseline_covariance_model: Published session covariance: C_used = (n / n_eff) * scatter_scale * C_formal, where C_formal solves P_sum*C=I and P_sum=sum(solve(C_i,I)); n_eff is the number of contiguous source/direction sessions, with no independence claimed between 1 Hz epochs inside one RTK FIXED session
quality.independent_epoch_covariance_model: Sensitivity only: C_edge = scatter_scale * inverse(sum(inverse(C_i))); assumes n_eff=n
quality.effective_sample_size_method: Published n_eff: one independent observation per contiguous source/direction session separated by direction change or >5 s gap. Per-component ACF ESS is diagnostic only
quality.loop_basis_method: Rover-to-rover-first spanning forest plus one fundamental cycle per chord; BASE edges only anchor rover components and dependent cycles are intentionally omitted

global_test.interpretation: One-sided upper-tail Chi-square network quality test. A statistic below the critical value passes; a very small statistic does not fail the network and is diagnosed separately as conservative weighting.

stochastic_model_test.interpretation: Two-sided diagnostic of the stochastic model only. A value below the lower bound means assigned covariance is conservative; it is not a network-quality failure.

independent_epoch_sensitivity.assumption: All accepted raw epochs are statistically independent.
